best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding transcriptional cluster was identified using intersections between GH146-GAL4 and drivers for newly identified marker genes (Li et al., 2017). Clusters at other stages were matched to it by Xie et al. (2021), based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression. Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult antennal lobe projection neuron DL3 lPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: DL3 lPNs. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: lPN 147, APL 3, unlabelled 1.
